scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:migrate: npm --prefix server exec prisma migrate dev --name init
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
